body:
Hi,

Are you agree with the idea to add a reference to the [OWASP Secure Headers Project](https://owasp.org/www-project-secure-headers/) into the following area:
* The [references section](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#references) of the **V14-Config** part.
* The [Appendix B](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x91-Appendix-B_References.md#appendix-b-references)

Do not hesitate to contact me if we can push the integration a little further with the OSHP 😃 

Reference issue on the OSHP working plan: https://github.com/oshp/oshp-tracking/issues/3

Thank you very much in advance 😃

comments.body:
Hi @righettod,

Yes we definitely should :)

Can you check for me if there are any references in ASVS to other security header resources which are out of date?

Please then open a PR adding the relevant references and removing any old/outdated/incorrect references.

Thanks!

Merged.

My concern is how and is the Secure Headers Project up-to-date with content and aligned with ASVS.

Hi @elarlang and @tghosth 

The OSHP project is active and content is updated as often as possible.

In addition, resources added to OSHP are monitored regarding any broken links or github repo not maintained.

Roadmap and OSHP org content are clearly defined.

All our exchange are public and we made public POC before recommending any technical content.

Regarding the alignment with the ASVS. References to OSHP were only added into ASVS sections in which security headers are mentioned. 

Feel free to ask me any question/concern regarding the OSHP content and update issue.

title: Add reference to the OWASP Secure Headers Project
